Correct. Fold: each runner's audit requires a positive marker of the selected tool-less agent (kimi: wire tool snapshot present and == []; agy: the containment log names the tool-less agent); missing or mismatched marker is a breach; phase 1 RED fixture for each.

The 14 KB figure in R10 is the drafting target the plan author set; the canonical size control for a plan under review is the bounded-repair growth gate (≤1.25× R0, here 17.1/14.2 = 1.20, inside). R10's intent — a complete, focused plan — is met; deleting adjudicated constraints to hit a byte count would weaken it. No closeout byte assertion is added.
